name: mantaprint
description: MantaPrint Hub - Universal Multi-Device USB-to-Wireless Print & Scan Hub for Legacy Printers

scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --prefix frontend && mkdir -p src/web/dist && rsync -av --delete --exclude=scanner --exclude=hdmi frontend/dist/ src/web/dist/
scripts.build:pwa: npm run build --prefix apps/scanner-pwa && mkdir -p src/web/dist/scanner && cp -r apps/scanner-pwa/dist/* src/web/dist/scanner/
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:pwa
scripts.lint: bash -n install.sh scripts/*.sh system/bin/* && python3 -m py_compile src/core/*.py src/web/*.py

author: Mantaplex
